title: gaps.yaml entry
description: One gap: a falsifiable claim whose probe is not yet (or no longer) GREEN. The machine layer beside a suite's GAPS.md prose. Enforced at parse time by recurvelib/model.py (parse, don't validate).

id.description: Stable id matching GAPS.md numbering: <PREFIX>-<num> or a token id.

class.description: The closed six. New domains map onto these via a Conventions section in their GAPS.md prose — never new enum values.

status.description: open/sculpting → probe expected RED; closed → expected GREEN; permanent → no probe.

reads.description: Which built artifact the probe reads — the freshness axis. Must name a reads rule configured in recurve.toml so the runner can refuse to run the probe against stale artifacts.

evidence.description: file:line pointers into the target tree proving the gap is real.

observed.description: The exact string/behavior observed today (actual dated output, never a prediction).

smallest_fix.description: The minimal honest change that closes it. Adjudicated policy decisions are recorded here (DECIDED <date>: ...).

probe.description: Path (relative to the suite dir) to the executable probe. REQUIRED unless status=permanent.

unlocks.description: What gets STRONGER when this closes (the sculptor's compass).

covers.description: GAPS.md section anchor(s) this entry addresses. The prose↔ledger link `coverage` checks so no documented gap stays invisible to the loop.

trap_waiver.description: Reason this probe carries no trap fixture (see the probe contract). Counted and listed by `validate` as visible debt.

needs_authoring.description: Set by `import`; delete once class/severity/probe are real.
